reasoning.assessment: setEncoding utf8 precedes listener registration. At ordinary data-entry the prior suffix has no newline. prefixLength + first newline index from the new decoded string equals the original whole-buffer index. No-newline events append without scanning prior text. The unchanged suffix loop drains all remaining lines, including blank CRLF lines; continue still executes the for update expression. An empty decoded chunk leaves state unchanged. UTF-16 length and indices agree even for astral characters.

The original aggregate UTF-16 limit is checked before any parsing, so an over-limit chunk containing early complete lines is rejected in full. The retained buffer remains over limit and cannot re-enter parsing on later data. Malformed JSON, null shape errors and throwing message listeners still close then continue suffix parsing as before. These are inherited semantics, not new guards or byte-based limits.

Request/control correlation and notification routing are unchanged. Settlement clears the specific pending timer before deletion. Timeout deletes its own pending entry. send failure and close reject pending work and clear its timers; later responses become ordinary messages. Cancellation retains partial input until actual child close, preserving fragmented in-flight notifications.

The first child-close listener resolves exited. Promise continuations are microtasks, so the later synchronous close listener clears #buffer before exited continuations run. It clears before calling close, hence before first closed notification on natural exit, and also clears when close was already called. The kill-escalation timer closes over child, not this/#buffer, and remains unrefed for at most its existing delay. Its post-exit exitCode check avoids SIGKILL.
